volumes.title: KET 模拟卷一 · 校园生活
volumes.topic: 校园 · 学习 · 考试

questions.q: 听单词，选出正确的中文意思
questions.audio_text: library
questions.tip: library = 图书馆，注意与 lab（实验室）区分。

questions.q: 听单词，选出正确的中文意思
questions.audio_text: homework
questions.tip: homework 是不可数名词，意为家庭作业。

questions.q: 听短句，选出正确的翻译
questions.audio_text: I have an English lesson at nine o'clock.
questions.tip: have a lesson = 上课。

questions.q: 听短句，选出正确的翻译
questions.audio_text: Our teacher is very kind to us.
options: 我们的老师对我们很严格
我们的老师对我们很和蔼
我们的老师经常表扬我们
questions.tip: be kind to sb = 对某人友好/和蔼。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: Can I borrow your pen, please? B: Sure. Here you are.
options: 借给 A 一支钢笔
questions.tip: Here you are. = 给你。borrow = 借入。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: How often do you have P.E. class? B: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Friday.
questions.tip: twice a week = 每周两次。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: I can't find my maths book. B: Maybe it's in your desk.
questions.tip: maybe = 也许。注意推测语气。

questions.q: 听短文，回答问题
questions.audio_text: Tom is a primary school student. He gets up at six thirty every morning. He walks to school with his best friend Jack. His favourite subject is science because he likes doing experiments. After school, he plays basketball for an hour.

questions.q: How does Tom go to school?
questions.tip: walks to school = 步行上学，即 on foot。

questions.q: Why does Tom like science?
questions.tip: because he likes doing experiments = 因为他喜欢做实验。

questions.q: What does Tom do after school?
questions.tip: plays basketball for an hour = 打一小时篮球。

questions.q: 跟读下列句子（口语题）
questions.audio_text: My favourite subject is English, because I like speaking with my classmates.
questions.tip: 注意 favourite 的重音在第一个音节，speaking 的 ng 音要读到位。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: Who is the girl in the photo? B: She is my cousin. She lives in Shanghai and she is two years older than me.
questions.tip: cousin = 堂（表）姐妹；older than = 比……大。

questions.q: 听短文，回答问题
questions.audio_text: Our school has three interesting clubs. The Music Club meets on Monday afternoon. Students there play the guitar, the piano or sing songs. The Sports Club is very popular. Children play basketball and football after class on Tuesday and Thursday. The Art Club is on Friday. Students draw pictures and make cards. You can join the club you like at the office on the first floor.

questions.q: When does the Music Club meet?
questions.tip: The Music Club meets on Monday afternoon.

questions.q: What do students do in the Sports Club?
questions.tip: Children play basketball and football after class on Tuesday and Thursday.

questions.q: Where can students join a club?
options: At the office on the first floor
questions.tip: You can join the club at the office on the first floor.

questions.q: 跟读下列句子（口语题）
questions.audio_text: After school, I often go to the library to read story books with my friends.
questions.tip: 注意 often 的 t 可轻读，story 的 o 音要饱满。

volumes.title: KET 模拟卷二 · 家庭与休闲
volumes.topic: 家庭 · 周末 · 爱好

questions.q: 听单词，选出正确的中文意思
questions.audio_text: weekend
questions.tip: weekend = 周末，指周六和周日。

questions.q: 听单词，选出正确的中文意思
questions.audio_text: hobby
questions.tip: hobby = 爱好，如 collecting stamps 集邮。

questions.q: 听短句，选出正确的翻译
questions.audio_text: My family usually have dinner together on Sundays.
options: 我们家通常在周日一起吃晚饭
我们家通常在周日一起去公园
我们家通常在周日一起看电视
questions.tip: have dinner together = 一起吃晚饭。

questions.q: 听短句，选出正确的翻译
questions.audio_text: She spends two hours playing the piano every day.
options: 她每天花两小时弹钢琴
她每天花两小时练跑步
她每天花两小时写作业
questions.tip: spend time doing sth = 花时间做某事。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: What are you going to do this weekend? B: I'm going to visit my grandparents with my parents.
questions.tip: be going to = 打算做某事。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: Do you like swimming? B: Yes, but I like cycling better.
questions.tip: like ... better = 更喜欢……。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: How was your holiday? B: It was wonderful! We went to the beach every day.
questions.tip: wonderful = 棒极了。went to the beach = 去了海滩。

questions.q: 听短文，回答问题
questions.audio_text: Linda's family has four people: her father, her mother, her brother and her. On Saturday morning, they go to the supermarket together. Her father buys some bread and milk. Her mother buys vegetables and fruit. Linda and her brother buy a big cake. They have a picnic in the park at noon.

questions.q: How many people are there in Linda's family?
questions.tip: father, mother, brother and Linda = 4 人。

questions.q: What does her father buy?
questions.tip: Her father buys some bread and milk.

questions.q: Where do they have a picnic?
questions.tip: They have a picnic in the park at noon.

questions.q: 跟读下列句子（口语题）
questions.audio_text: On weekends, I like playing football with my friends in the park.
questions.tip: 注意 weekends 的 s 要轻读，playing 的 ing 音清晰。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: We planned a picnic tomorrow. But the weather report says it will rain. B: Then let's stay at home and watch a film instead.
questions.tip: weather report = 天气预报；stay at home = 待在家。

questions.q: 听短文，回答问题
questions.audio_text: Amy likes collecting stamps. She has stamps from more than twenty countries. Her friend Jack is interested in taking photos. He takes pictures of birds and flowers in the park. On Sunday afternoon, Amy and Jack usually go to the park with their families. They fly kites, ride bikes and have a small picnic under the big tree. Everyone enjoys the happy time together.

questions.q: What does Amy like doing?
questions.tip: Amy likes collecting stamps.

questions.q: What does Jack take pictures of?
questions.tip: He takes pictures of birds and flowers in the park.

questions.q: Where do they have a small picnic?
questions.tip: They have a small picnic under the big tree.

questions.q: 跟读下列句子（口语题）
questions.audio_text: My hobby is collecting stamps from different countries around the world.
questions.tip: 注意 collecting 双写 l，countries 的 ou 音。

volumes.title: KET 模拟卷三 · 饮食与购物
volumes.topic: 食物 · 餐厅 · 购物

questions.q: 听单词，选出正确的中文意思
questions.audio_text: vegetable
questions.tip: vegetable = 蔬菜，常与 fruit 一起记忆。

questions.q: 听单词，选出正确的中文意思
questions.audio_text: expensive
questions.tip: expensive = 昂贵的，反义词 cheap。

questions.q: 听短句，选出正确的翻译
questions.audio_text: I'd like a glass of orange juice, please.
questions.tip: a glass of = 一杯（玻璃杯）。

questions.q: 听短句，选出正确的翻译
questions.audio_text: The blue T-shirt is cheaper than the red one.
options: 蓝色T恤比红色那件便宜
蓝色T恤和红色那件一样贵
questions.tip: cheaper than = 比……更便宜。比较级。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: Can I help you? B: Yes, I'm looking for a school bag.
questions.tip: Can I help you? = 购物时的招呼语。looking for = 寻找。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: What would you like for lunch? B: I'd like some noodles with vegetables.
questions.tip: noodles with vegetables = 蔬菜面。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: How much is this jacket? B: It's fifty dollars. But it's on sale today, so you can get it for thirty.
questions.tip: on sale = 打折促销，30 美元是折后价。

questions.q: 听短文，回答问题
questions.audio_text: Yesterday was Jane's birthday. Her mother cooked a big dinner for her: chicken, fish, rice and vegetables. Her father bought a birthday cake with ten candles. Her friends came to her party and brought her presents. She got a new dress from her best friend Lucy. Everyone had a great time.

questions.q: Who cooked the dinner?
questions.tip: Her mother cooked a big dinner for her.

questions.q: What did her father buy?
questions.tip: Her father bought a birthday cake with ten candles.

questions.q: Who gave Jane a new dress?
questions.tip: She got a new dress from her best friend Lucy.

questions.q: 跟读下列句子（口语题）
questions.audio_text: I usually have bread and milk for breakfast, and I often eat fruit after dinner.
questions.tip: 注意 breakfast 的重音在第一个音节，fruit 的 u 音。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: Are you ready to order, sir? B: Yes, I'd like beef with rice and a cup of tea, please.
questions.tip: order = 点餐；beef with rice = 牛肉饭。

questions.q: 听短文，回答问题
questions.audio_text: Every Friday, the supermarket has a big sale. Milk is cheaper on that day, so many people buy it. Fruit like apples and bananas are also on sale. Linda's mother always makes a shopping list before going there. She buys food for the week and checks the prices carefully. She says it helps the family save a lot of money.

questions.q: When does the supermarket have a big sale?
questions.tip: Every Friday, the supermarket has a big sale.

questions.q: What does Linda's mother do before going shopping?
questions.tip: She always makes a shopping list before going there.

questions.q: Why does she check the prices carefully?
questions.tip: It helps the family save a lot of money.

questions.q: 跟读下列句子（口语题）
questions.audio_text: I often help my mother do some shopping at the supermarket on Saturday morning.
questions.tip: 注意 shopping 双写 p，supermarket 的重音在第一个音节。

volumes.title: KET 模拟卷四 · 旅行与城市
volumes.topic: 旅行 · 问路 · 城市地标

questions.q: 听单词，选出正确的中文意思
questions.audio_text: station
questions.tip: station = 车站，train station 火车站。

questions.q: 听单词，选出正确的中文意思
questions.audio_text: museum
questions.tip: museum = 博物馆，注意发音 /mjuˈziːəm/。

questions.q: 听短句，选出正确的翻译
questions.audio_text: Excuse me, how can I get to the city library?
options: 请问去市图书馆怎么走
请问市图书馆几点关门
请问市图书馆在哪里工作
questions.tip: How can I get to ...? = 我怎么去……？问路句型。

questions.q: 听短句，选出正确的翻译
questions.audio_text: The bus takes about twenty minutes to get to the airport.
options: 坐公交去机场大约需要二十分钟
坐地铁去机场大约需要二十分钟
走路去机场大约需要二十分钟
questions.tip: It takes ... to do = 做某事需要（时间）。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: Excuse me, where is the nearest bank? B: Go straight on, and turn left at the second crossing.
questions.tip: turn left at the second crossing = 在第二个十字路口左转。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: Shall we take the bus or the underground? B: The underground is faster. Let's take it.
questions.tip: underground = 地铁（英式），faster = 更快。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: What time does the train leave? B: At half past nine. We still have thirty minutes.
questions.tip: half past nine = 九点半；还有三十分钟，所以现在是九点。

questions.q: 听短文，回答问题
questions.audio_text: Last summer, Mike went to London with his parents. They visited the Tower Bridge and the British Museum. They took a boat trip on the River Thames and saw many famous buildings. Mike liked the food there, especially the fish and chips. They stayed in London for five days. Mike said he wanted to go there again.

questions.q: When did Mike go to London?
questions.tip: Last summer, Mike went to London with his parents.

questions.q: What did they do on the River Thames?
questions.tip: They took a boat trip on the River Thames.

questions.q: How long did they stay in London?
questions.tip: They stayed in London for five days.

questions.q: 跟读下列句子（口语题）
questions.audio_text: I like travelling by train because I can see the beautiful scenery on the way.
questions.tip: 注意 travelling 双写 l，scenery 的重音在第一个音节。

questions.q: 听对话，选择正确的答案
questions.audio_text: A: Excuse me, where is the museum? B: It's next to the post office. Take the second turning on your left and walk straight.
questions.tip: next to = 在……旁边；take the second turning = 在第二个路口转弯。

questions.q: 听短文，回答问题
questions.audio_text: There are different ways to travel around the city. The underground is the fastest, but it can be very crowded in the morning. The bus is cheaper, but it is slow because there are many stops. Many people now ride bicycles, because it is good for the environment and keeps them healthy. On sunny days, more and more people choose to walk short distances instead of taking buses.

questions.q: Why is the underground not always good?
questions.tip: It can be very crowded in the morning.

questions.q: Why do many people ride bicycles?
options: Because it is good for the environment and health
questions.tip: It is good for the environment and keeps them healthy.

questions.q: What do people do on sunny days?
questions.tip: People choose to walk short distances instead of taking buses.

questions.q: 跟读下列句子（口语题）
questions.audio_text: The underground is the fastest way to travel around the city centre.
questions.tip: 注意 underground 的重音在第一个音节，centre 的 re 轻读。
